Application Data.NAME: Sunny Day Toys
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sunny Day Toys specializes in the retail sale of a wide variety of children's toys, games, and educational products. Our store offers an engaging shopping experience with interactive displays and play areas for kids. We focus on providing high-quality, safe, and age-appropriate toys to families in our community. In addition to traditional toys, we also offer seasonal items, outdoor play equipment, and unique gift selections. Our knowledgeable staff is dedicated to helping customers find the perfect products for their children.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2022, a customer slipped and fell in the store due to a wet floor that was not adequately marked, resulting in a claim of $1,500. The claim was settled and closed in July 2022. On 03/10/2023, a theft incident occurred where toys valued at $1,000 were stolen from the store. This claim is still pending investigation with the insurance company.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: UL Class 1, Grade A, Burglary Resistant, TAA Certified
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Surveillance cameras, security alarm system, and regular inspections by hired security personnel after hours.
